<file path="source.php">
namespace App\Medium;
use Generator;
use Closure;
use ReflectionException;
/** Interface for dependency injection container */
interface ContainerInterface {
    /**
     * Register a service in the container
     *
     * @param string $id Service identifier
     * @param callable|object $service Service factory or instance
     */
    public register(string $id, callable|object $service): void
    /**
     * Resolve a service from the container
     *
     * @param string $id Service identifier
     * @return mixed
     */
    public resolve(string $id): mixed
    /**
     * Check if service is registered
     *
     * @param string $id Service identifier
     * @return bool
     */
    public has(string $id): bool
}
/** Simple dependency injection container */
class Container implements ContainerInterface {
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public register(string $id, callable|object $service): void
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public resolve(string $id): mixed
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public has(string $id): bool
    /**
     * Auto-wire a class using reflection
     *
     * @param string $className Class name
     * @return object
     * @throws ReflectionException
     */
    public autowire(string $className): object
}
/**
 * Generic repository interface
 *
 * @template T
 */
interface RepositoryInterface {
    /**
     * Find entity by ID
     *
     * @param int $id Entity ID
     * @return T|null
     */
    public find(int $id): ?object
    /**
     * Find all entities
     *
     * @return list<T>
     */
    public findAll(): T[]
    /**
     * Save entity
     *
     * @param T $entity Entity to save
     * @return T
     */
    public save(T $entity): T
    /**
     * Delete entity
     *
     * @param T $entity Entity to delete
     */
    public delete(T $entity): void
}
/**
 * Abstract base repository
 *
 * @template T
 * @implements RepositoryInterface<T>
 */
abstract class AbstractRepository implements RepositoryInterface {
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public find(int $id): ?object
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public findAll(): array
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public save(object $entity): object
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public delete(object $entity): void
    /**
     * Find entities by criteria using closures
     *
     * @param Closure $criteria Criteria closure
     * @return Generator<T>
     */
    public findBy(Closure $criteria): Generator
}
/** Event interface */
interface EventInterface {
    /**
     * Get event name
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public getName(): string
    /**
     * Get event data
     *
     * @return array
     */
    public getData(): array
}
/** Event listener interface */
interface EventListenerInterface {
    /**
     * Handle the event
     *
     * @param EventInterface $event Event to handle
     */
    public handle(EventInterface $event): void
}
/** Simple event dispatcher */
class EventDispatcher {
    /**
     * Subscribe to an event
     *
     * @param string $eventName Event name
     * @param EventListenerInterface $listener Event listener
     */
    public subscribe(string $eventName, EventListenerInterface $listener): void
    /**
     * Dispatch an event
     *
     * @param EventInterface $event Event to dispatch
     */
    public dispatch(EventInterface $event): void
    /**
     * Create anonymous event listener
     *
     * @param string $eventName Event name
     * @param Closure $handler Event handler
     */
    public listen(string $eventName, Closure $handler): void
}
/** Simple event implementation */
class Event implements EventInterface {
    /**
     * Create new event
     *
     * @param string $name Event name
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data Event data
     */
    public __construct(string $name, array<string, mixed> $data = [])
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public getName(): string
    /** @inheritDoc */
    public getData(): array
}
/** User entity with advanced features */
class User {
    /**
     * Create new user
     *
     * @param int|null $id User ID
     * @param string $name User name
     * @param string $email User email
     */
    public __construct(?int $id, string $name, string $email)
    public getId(): ?int
    public setId(int $id): void
    public getName(): string
    public getEmail(): string
}
/**
 * User repository
 *
 * @extends AbstractRepository<User>
 */
class UserRepository extends AbstractRepository {
    /**
     * Find users by email domain
     *
     * @param string $domain Email domain
     * @return Generator<User>
     */
    public findByEmailDomain(string $domain): Generator
    /**
     * Get user statistics
     *
     * @return array
     */
    public getStatistics(): array
}
/** Service with dependency injection */
class UserService {
    /**
     * Create user service
     *
     * @param UserRepository $repository User repository
     * @param EventDispatcher $dispatcher Event dispatcher
     */
    public __construct(UserRepository $repository, EventDispatcher $dispatcher)
    /**
     * Create new user
     *
     * @param string $name User name
     * @param string $email User email
     * @return User
     */
    public createUser(string $name, string $email): User
    /**
     * Get user statistics using generator
     *
     * @return Generator<string, mixed>
     */
    public getUserStatistics(): Generator
}
